title: Oracle shadow simulation for one step
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, $S$ a state type, $x$ a Boolean input word, $i$ one of $n$ tape indices, $A$ a machine on $n$ Boolean tapes, $c$ a configuration, and $b$ a Boolean tag. If the head position on tape $i$ lies on the side of the origin indicated by $b$—nonnegative when $b$ is true and nonpositive when it is false—then there is a tag $b'$ such that after one step of $A$ the head position on tape $i$ lies on the side indicated by $b'$, and one step of the augmented shadow machine from the augmented configuration equals the augmentation of the one-step successor with tag $b'$.
hypotheses_covered: initial head position lies on the side indicated by $b$
